investigation_notes: Network security investigation of a monitored LAN. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over Zeek and Suricata logs (IDS alerts, Kerberos, HTTP downloads, TLS certificates, domains and external-destination activity). No root cause, impact or C2 attribution is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Network context: LAN segment range: 10.7.10.0/24 (10.7.10.1 through 10.7.10.255); Domain: coolweathercoat.com; Domain controller IP address: 10.7.10.9; Domain controller hostname: WIN-S3WT6LGQFVX; LAN segment gateway: 10.7.10.1; LAN segment broadcast address: 10.7.10.255.
